### Background
> Why was this decision necessary? (e.g., model selection, data source change, framework/library adoption, pipeline architecture, etc.)

### Options

| Option | Pros | Cons | Performance/Cost Metrics |
|------|------|------|----------------|
|      |      |      |                |
|      |      |      |                |

### Decision
> Which option was chosen and what is the core rationale? (include criteria such as accuracy, training/inference speed, data availability, maintenance cost, etc.)

### Outcome and Follow-up
> Constraints and technical debt resulting from this decision, timing for retraining/revalidation, and items for future review.
